title: Verniman method: auction, order flow and execution knowledge base
summary: A source-backed method library covering 27 blog topics, plus a local Daily Map archive for January 1–October 30, 2026 with dated text/image records and explicit gaps.
data_summary: Method review: 27 pages, 46 videos, 42 retained caption exports. Daily Map: 201 dated maps across 198 days, two undated commentaries, 417 images; all 303 calendar dates recorded. No market-data calculations.
evidence_status: Qualitative source research and local source preservation. Method media gaps remain; Daily Map retains 19 weekday gaps, three duplicate date pairs, one historical recovery and two inline image fallbacks. No trading validation.
